channel.title: Engineering Digest
channel.description: Daily digest of engineering blog posts from top tech companies

item.title: Follow the thread: a new dashboard to investigate account abuse
item.description: Fraudsters are increasingly using AI to bypass stateless security checks Cloudflare's new Account Abuse Protection dashboard uses stateful analysis and edge-generated Hashed User IDs to help teams investigate and block account abuse.

item.title: Protected Quick Tunnels: simple accountless authentication for your next dev project
item.description: Quick Tunnels now support email authentication Add --allowed-mail to one cloudflared command, and only the addresses or domains you list can reach your local app No Cloudflare account required on either side.

item.title: Building for good: How civil society organizations are automating on Cloudflare
item.description: Some of the world's leading organizations are building the future of non-profit work with Cloudflare.
